cards.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah becomes king of Israel. He reigns in Samaria nine years. Nine years, friend. Most of my cookies don't last nine MINUTES.

cards.question: True or false: King Hoshea of Israel does even more evil than the kings of Israel who came before him.

cards.text: Then Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, attacks Hoshea, and Hoshea becomes his vassal and pays him tribute. Basically, Hoshea's got a subscription he can't cancel, and Assyria is sending the bill.

cards.question: Hoshea conspires and sends envoys to another king behind Assyria's back. Which king?
True or false: Hoshea keeps paying tribute to the king of Assyria like he did in previous years.
The king of Assyria finds out about Hoshea's envoys and the missing payments. What does he do to Hoshea?

answers.text: Arrests him and puts him in prison
Makes him pay double the next year
Sends him away to live in Egypt

cards.text: Then the king of Assyria invades the whole land and marches up to Samaria. The king of Israel is already locked up, friend, and the army is STILL coming.

cards.question: The king of Assyria besieges Samaria for ___ years.

cards.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea, friend, Samaria can't hold out any longer. The king of Assyria captures the city.

cards.question: After Samaria falls, the king of Assyria carries the Israelites away to ___.

cards.text: He settles them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes. And the question hanging over all of it, friend, is WHY.
Now the writer pauses the story to tell us why. All this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God.

cards.question: The writer reminds us who the LORD is to Israel. What had He done for them long before?
True or false: Israel worshiped other gods and walked in the customs of the nations the LORD had driven out before them.

cards.text: The Israelites secretly do things against the LORD their God that are not right. And they build high places in all their cities, from the tiniest watchtower to the biggest fortified city, like a franchise opening one on EVERY corner.

cards.question: Israel sets up sacred pillars and Asherah poles for themselves. Where do they put them?

answers.text: On high hills and under green trees
Along the banks of the Jordan

cards.text: They burn incense on the high places, just like the nations the LORD drove out. And they serve idols, even though the LORD had told them, "You shall not do this thing."
Yet through all His prophets and seers, the LORD warns Israel and Judah. He doesn't send one reminder, friend, He sends a whole TEAM.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell Israel and Judah through His prophets and seers?
True or false: Israel listens to the prophets and turns back to the LORD.

cards.text: Instead they stiffened their necks like their fathers, who did not believe the LORD their God. That's the move where somebody calls your name and you just keep staring at your phone, except it's a WHOLE NATION.

cards.question: Israel rejects the LORD's covenant and chases after worthless idols. They become ___ themselves.

cards.text: And they don't just bend the commandments, friend. They abandon ALL of them, and they make idols for themselves.

cards.question: Along with an Asherah pole, what idols does Israel make for themselves?

answers.text: A bronze serpent on a pole

cards.text: They bow down to all the host of heaven, and they serve Baal. Friend, this list just keeps going.

cards.question: Israel practices divination and soothsaying, and they go even further with their own sons and daughters. What do they do?

cards.text: Now here's where it all lands, friend. The LORD is very angry with Israel, and He removes them from His presence.

cards.question: After the LORD removes Israel from His presence, only the tribe of ___ remains.
True or false: The tribe of Judah keeps the commandments of the LORD their God.

cards.text: So the LORD rejects all the descendants of Israel, and this part is heavy, friend. He afflicts them and hands them over to plunderers, until He has banished them from His presence.
Then the writer hits rewind to the day the kingdom split. When the LORD tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king.

cards.question: What does King Jeroboam do to Israel?

answers.text: Leads them away from following the LORD
Leads them back to the house of David
Leads them out of the land to Egypt

cards.question: True or false: After Jeroboam, the Israelites finally turn away from the sins he committed.
Finally, the LORD removes Israel from His presence. How had He declared this would happen?

answers.text: Through all His servants the prophets
Through a dream given to Hoshea
Through a sign written on a wall

cards.text: So Israel is exiled from their homeland into Assyria, where they are to this day. It's a heavy ending, friend, but don't miss how many prophets the LORD sent to warn them first.
